title: Percentage of Pedestrian Crossings with Bollards of Crash Test Standards
what_it_is: Percentage of Pedestrian Crossings with Bollards of Crash Test Standards

sections.label: Bollard standards at pedestrian crossings
sections.summary: LTA bollards at pedestrian crossings are not of the K4, K8 or K12 standards stated by the Member.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The bollards installed at pedestrian crossings by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) are not of the K4, K8 or K12 standards stated by the Member.

sections.label: Safety bollards at signalised junctions
sections.summary: LTA's safety bollards at around 100 signalised junctions protect pedestrians while absorbing vehicle impact, unlike security bollards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The bollards that LTA has installed at around 100 signalised junctions are safety bollards that help protect pedestrians waiting to cross the road.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: They are designed to balance absorbing the impact from a vehicle and not causing serious injury to passengers in the vehicle.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In contrast, as security bollards are designed to withstand high impact collisions without yielding, when a vehicle hits a security bollard, the vehicle will likely suffer severe damage and the passengers in the vehicle risk serious or even fatal injury.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: First, let me say that the bollards, the ones that are at the bus stops as well as the signalised junctions at pedestrian crossings are designed to do both.

sections.label: Safety bollards absorb impact
sections.summary: Safety bollards absorb impact to protect pedestrians and vehicle passengers, and may break or fall off while doing so.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Whereas for the safety bollards, because we are balancing both the impact, protecting the pedestrians as well as the passengers in the vehicles, they absorb the impact.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: At the same time, they could break or fall off whilst absorbing the impact.

sections.label: Steel and concrete standards compliance
sections.summary: The bollards are built with steel and concrete structures complying with standards adapted from European standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Of course, these are also built with the steel and concrete structure in compliance with various standards that are an adaptation of the European standards.
